messages:
Aisha (Finance): Heads-up: BeaconHealth flagged renewal invoice RNL-2026-09 — platform fee is lower than the SOW. Customer says they signed for Platform_v4 but invoice uses Platform_v2 price.

Liam (Account Exec): That's not right. BeaconHealth negotiated Platform_v4 at $48k/yr and Support Premium. They signed on 2026-08-05. Can you paste invoice lines?

Rosa (Billing Ops): Invoice preview: ```
Invoice: RNL-2026-09
Customer: BeaconHealth
Period: 2026-09-01 - 2027-08-31
Lines:
- DEDICATED_POOL_ANNUAL Reserved GPU capacity (annual) $240,000
- PLATFORM_SUBSCRIPTION_ANNUAL Platform subscription (annual) $18,000
- SUPPORT_TIER_STANDARD Support - standard (annual) $6,000
Total: $264,000
```

Liam (Account Exec): Oof. Platform should be $48k and support $24k. That explains their escalation.

Rosa (Billing Ops): Quick root cause: renewal engine uses contract snapshot plus price-mapping. There was a failure in sku_mapping job for PRIVATE_PLATFORM_V4 so mapping fell back to catalog default (v2), resulting in underpricing. The contract snapshot still references the correct sku id, but mapping failed at invoice-render.

Aisha (Finance): So we undercharged. Customer expects higher invoice; if we increase now it will be awkward. Options: 1) Reissue invoice with correct pricing (increase) 2) Honor quoted/expected total now and log internal write-off 3) Offer a phased correction next year. Thoughts?

June (Legal): Check SOW: signed 2026-08-05, lists Platform_v4 @ $48k and Support Premium @ $24k. Legally we can invoice correct amount, but customer relations matter. If we want to increase mid-term, require CS + Sales alignment. Also check if SOW has billing timing clause.

Nate (RevRec): Any customer-facing concession changes will affect revenue recognition. If we reissue higher invoice, we need to amend cash collection expectations. If we honor lower invoice, we'll book a write-off or internal adjustment. FP&A needs to approve >$25k adjustments.

Liam (Account Exec): Sales recommends honoring billed amount for this term to avoid churn — but we should attempt to recover 50% next renewal or via a separate amendment with BeaconHealth's consent. We'll present that to customer as a one-time accommodation.

Aisha (Finance): Proposed playbook: 1) Void + reissue invoice RNL-2026-09A with Platform=48k and Support=24k but include a line "Concession - Billing Error" for -$48,000 to keep their payable unchanged; 2) Create internal memo (INTCORR-304) to capture the $48k concession as ledger adjustment; 3) Engineering ticket BF-1932 to add strict sku_mapping validation to the renewal pipeline. This keeps ledger prices accurate while preserving customer relationship. Approve?

Rosa (Billing Ops): We can void+reissue and attach concession line. That will produce the right contract-level pricing in the system. It takes 1 business day after approvals; RevRec must sign off.

June (Legal): Approve wording for concession note. Recommend adding: "This concession is issued to align invoicing with the signed SOW; no admission of liability."

Nate (RevRec): OK pending FP&A sign-off. Please route the internal memo and estimate of revenue impact. If FP&A signs, we can proceed.

billing-bot: Created ticket TKT-8603 for RNL-2026-09 reissue. Patch branch billing/fix/sku-mapping-1932 created.

Aisha (Finance): I'll prepare the reissue + internal memo and loop FP&A. Liam please coordinate customer messaging and confirm Sales approves the concession approach.

Liam (Account Exec): Will do. I'll draft an email offering the concession and ask for a short acknowledgement so we can close the loop.

Aisha (Finance): Thanks all — will update thread after FP&A sign-off.

Liam (Account Exec): Thanks team. Appreciate the quick response. :thumbsup:
